<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**7** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7c702ff24193b225cbdf422c32721b742e817dd9` — the merge of head `ebe4121a372efd9d4ed1c58d9346a6eefff1f60a` into base `5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7c702ff24193b225cbdf422c32721b742e817dd9 && git checkout 7c702ff24193b225cbdf422c32721b742e817dd9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11 ebe4121a372efd9d4ed1c58d9346a6eefff1f60a && git checkout -B drift-repro 5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11 && git merge --no-ff ebe4121a372efd9d4ed1c58d9346a6eefff1f60a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

- **Failure read:** `check:closing-target-claim` named `claude/issue-32798-mail-notice-retire` as the governing branch of #32798. The card thread's re-posted claim 6836772853 mentioned that provisional seat branch on its `Branch:` line, so the reader (`CLAIM_BRANCH_SHAPE`, issue-shaped names only) took it as the claim.
- **Repair, no push:** the card thread re-posted the whole claim (6838174199) whose `Branch:` line names only `claude/project-thread-3dk1rc`. The guard now reads that card as UNDETERMINED (the measured card-thread shape, PR #32845), not as claimed by another branch.
- **Why a re-run is the right act:** the head did not move and the input the guard reads (the card thread) changed; this is not a flake judgement on code.

**ACCEPT** · PR #32888 · head `ebe4121a372efd9d4ed1c58d9346a6eefff1f60a` · 2026-11-12T23:27Z · `Fixes #32798`

## 席位核对

1. **Shape:** draft PR to `main`, first line cites the card, `Fixes #32798` alone (no other open card number beside a closing keyword). Path surface (read from the file list, not the report): `packages/services/service-settings/src/{deployment-notice.ts,deployment-notice.routes.test.ts,settings-service-plugin.ts}`, `packages/cli/test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts`, `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`, one changeset. No governed path; 108 changed lines. Tier S.
2. **Premise measured:** `email_not_configured` was raised by `readDeploymentNotice` whenever `IEmailService.isConfigured()` was not `true`; no runtime produces a "needs mail and cannot send" signal (the dev's grep set, and the one near-miss, a boot-time log in plugin-auth, is not served). Route **retire**, as the seat's order chose within the ruling on #32643. `DeploymentFindingId` / `DeploymentNoticeSources` are not reachable from the package entry, so `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold.
3. **Gates:** check-runs on this head: 39 success, 17 skipped, 0 pending. The one red row is the superseded first run of PR-body guards (claim-reader trap, seat note 6838187842); its re-run on the same head is green.
4. **Accepted deviations:** file surface widened by the dev's re-posted claim to `settings-service-plugin.ts` (the now-unread source) and the CLI end-to-end pin, both of which named the finding. Ablation recorded in the PR (12 red, restored).
5. **Prose checked sentence by sentence:** the changeset's three paragraphs (the finding is gone; the fingerprint no longer changes when mail is configured; the one-time re-show of a hide recorded against the old fingerprint) and the `self-hosting.mdx` sentence ("Mail is optional and is not one of them") agree with the diff. "The Console stopped drawing this finding in an earlier change" holds: PR #32797 merged 2026-11-12T20:05Z.
6. **Out of scope:** the Console header prose and test fixtures still naming the id, and the `deploymentNotice.finding.emailNotConfigured` key left unreferenced in the 11 i18n packs: Acceptance notes (no user-visible effect; the Console drops unknown ids). `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`, no narrowing arm).
- **Landing:** K = 11 commits behind `main` (< 15), no new language pack since the merge base: no merge needed. Landed by the seat under the maintainer's standing word (「所有车道座位，应该使用pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地 pr」) and the 18.4.0 amendment (「已经在开发的 p2 可以继续跟进到 合并」).
